comment: Canonical list of legendary-arena.com subdomains. Read by scripts/check-subdomains.mjs. When adding or changing an entry, also update DOMAINS.md (one section per anchor). Field reference: see DOMAINS.md §Adding a new subdomain.

domains.name: Apex (legendary-arena.com)
domains.notes: Apex redirects to www via a zone-level Cloudflare Redirect Rule on the legendary-arena.com zone (Rules -> Redirect Rules), NOT via Pages _redirects (CF Pages does not support full-URL source patterns in _redirects). Direction is locked: apex -> www. Live since 2026-05-09 (WP-006 lock).

domains.name: Marketing (www)
domains.notes: Live since 2026-05-09 (WP-006 lock). CF Pages project: legendary-arena-website.

domains.name: Game client (play)
domains.notes: Live since 2026-05-10 (WP-007a lock). CF Pages project: legendary-arena-play. Cross-origin brand-tokens contract verified against https://www.legendary-arena.com/brand-tokens.css; bundled local fallback at /brand-tokens.local.css verified byte-identical to live URL (SHA-256 70C11CEB...). Server CORS allowlist updated under EC-147 to include https://play.legendary-arena.com and https://legendary-arena-play.pages.dev.

domains.name: Registry viewer (cards)
domains.notes: Live since 2026-07-08. CF Pages project: legendary-arena (custom domain cards.legendary-arena.com attached alongside the legendary-arena.pages.dev placeholder). The registry-viewer SPA makes no API calls: card data loads from images.legendary-arena.com/metadata at runtime (no auth, no server contact). The server CORS allowlist still includes this hostname (WP-146).

domains.name: Public player wiki
domains.source: TBD - separate Hugo site (not yet authored)

domains.name: Engineering wiki (private, gated)
domains.source: apps/wiki-viewer (Hugo build of wiki/); Worker legendary-arena-wiki
domains.notes: Live since 2026-05-08; served by the assets-only Cloudflare Worker legendary-arena-wiki since the D-24690 cutover (workers_dev and preview_urls off, so the custom domain is the only hostname). Cloudflare Access redirects unauthenticated probes to login (302) or rejects them (401/403). A 200 here means the gate is misconfigured and the private wiki is publicly readable. expectedLocation is a prefix; the Access login URL appends a long JWT in the query string that varies per request.

domains.name: Engineering wiki (retired Render origin, must 404)
domains.source: none — Render static site legendary-arena-wiki, retired by D-24690
domains.notes: The retired Render service's built-in onrender.com host. It served the full wiki UNGATED (observed 200 on 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-11) because the ewiki Access application gates only ewiki.legendary-arena.com. D-24690 moved the ewiki to a Cloudflare Worker, and the Render service was deleted on 2026-10-11, so Render answers 404 for this host. Kept as a regression probe: any 200 here means a service named legendary-arena-wiki exists on Render again and must be deleted (DOMAINS.md#ewiki).

domains.name: Legends scoreboard (public attract board)
domains.notes: Live since 2026-07-08. CF Pages project: legendary-arena-legends. Public, no-auth. Reads leaderboard JSON snapshots from R2 (written by WP-142 publisher) via images.legendary-arena.com. The leaderboards make no API calls; the one exception is the #/match/<id> result panel and its download, which call GET api.legendary-arena.com/api/match/:id/result-lagn (WP-407/408, VITE_LEGENDS_API_BASE_URL). A 200 here proves the SPA shell loads; snapshot freshness is a separate concern verified by the publisher's own health check (GET /health/legends-publisher). NOTE at cutover: the WP-142 publisher was still idle (LEGENDS_PUBLISHER_ENABLED unset), so panels render the no-data state until it is enabled — a data-supply concern, not a board defect.

domains.name: Internal admin dashboard
domains.notes: Live since 2026-06-02. Served by the assets-only Cloudflare Worker legendary-arena-dashboard since the D-24690 cutover (workers_dev and preview_urls off); before that, the CF Pages project legendary-arena-dashboard. Cloudflare Access (Self-hosted, Email OTP, single-operator allow = jeff@barefootbetters.com) redirects unauthenticated probes to login (302) or rejects them (401/403). A 200 here means the gate is misconfigured and the dashboard is publicly readable. expectedLocation is a prefix; the Access login URL appends a long JWT in the query string that varies per request. Launched in mock mode (D-19702); now a live-mode build (VITE_USE_MOCKS=false, VITE_API_BASE_URL=https://api.legendary-arena.com, Hanko sign-in; read from the deployed bundle 2026-10-10), so a missing gate exposes the live operator dashboard with only the server's admin-session check in front of live data.

domains.name: API (game server, friendly hostname)
domains.host: DigitalOcean droplet (proxied; Origin cert, Full strict)
domains.notes: Proxied Cloudflare A record api.legendary-arena.com -> the self-hosted DigitalOcean droplet (Ubuntu 24.04, sfo3) since the 2026-10-12 cutover. Nginx on the droplet terminates TLS with a Cloudflare Origin Certificate; the api hosts run SSL Full (strict) through a Configuration Rule while the rest of the zone stays on Full. The server is the systemd unit la-server; provisioning and deploys live in the legendary-arena-lab repo. Live since 2026-05-09; from then until 2026-10-12 this was a DNS-only CNAME to legendary-arena-server.onrender.com (Render). Rollback during the 7-day window restores that CNAME exactly and resumes the Render service. PUBLIC_BASE_URL is unrelated to this hostname — it is the CLIENT URL Stripe Checkout redirects users to after success/cancel (see apps/server/src/billing/billing.routes.ts).

domains.name: API (retired Render origin, rollback only)
domains.source: none — Render web service legendary-arena-server, suspended at the 2026-10-12 cutover
domains.notes: Not a production hostname since the 2026-10-12 cutover. The Render web service is suspended for the 7-day rollback window (then Render is deleted, ~2026-10-20), so this host no longer serves the game: a suspended service is expected to answer 503 and a deleted one 404 (as legendary-arena-wiki.onrender.com does). Kept as a probe, like the retired ewiki origin above: a 200 here means the Render service is running again. That is expected only during a rollback, when api.legendary-arena.com points back here; otherwise suspend or delete it.

domains.name: Card images CDN
domains.notes: Canonical host since 2026-07-16; legacy images.barefootbetters.com is a second custom domain on the same bucket and remains live (no redirect). Bucket index commonly returns 403 or 404; specific keys return 200. Probe verifies DNS/TLS reachability, not bucket contents.
